request: I fly to London on January 19 for the NHS Supply Chain negotiation on January 21 - business class one way, please. Henrik approved the trip.

trip.purpose: Supply contract negotiation in central London
notes: Central London is served by London Gatwick (LGW) as well as London Heathrow (LHR).

must_keep.quote: 3.1 Airline Class of Service Employees are to use the lowest logical airfare as defined in Section 3.2. Class of service is predicated upon the length of individual flight segment and position in the Company as follows: Segment Duration Position < 6 hours > 6 hours and < 10 hours > 10 hours ELT Standard Business Standard Business Standard Business Vice Presidents and above Coach / Economy Standard Business Standard Business All other employees Coach / Economy Coach/ Economy Premium Coach / Economy Plus
must_keep.why: the class of service per segment length and position

must_keep.quote: Alternate airports will also be considered when researching the lowest fare available (e.g. traveling to/from Batesville, the airports offered would be Cincinnati or Indianapolis. Other examples would be Dallas Ft. Worth and Dallas Love Field, Chicago Midway and Chicago O'Hare, or London Gatwick and London Heathrow).
must_keep.why: alternate airports such as Gatwick and Heathrow

must_keep.quote: For travel between continents, travelers are expected to book the lowest logical airfare based on the following parameters: • Routing does not increase the one-way total elapsed trip time (origin to destination) by more than three (3) hours. • Savings must be at least $1,000 to offset schedule inconvenience.
International travel (travel between continents) requires pre-travel authorization from the employee's ELT representative or Regional President. Such approval should be documented in writing

design_notes: A Vice President over six hours: business (433). Alternate airports are considered, Gatwick for Heathrow by name (456-459), and the trip record names Gatwick as serving central London: Gatwick business saves 132000 cents (at least $1,000) and adds 5 minutes, so every reading books it.
